source.description:
PROBLEM: Fleet rows show identity (specialist, model, bead, state, elapsed, spend) but not intent -- an operator with three running specialists cannot tell WHY each was dispatched without opening each bead. The bead contract already states the reason (SCOPE/SUCCESS); it just never reaches the row.

SUCCESS: Each fleet row carries a short purpose excerpt (e.g. `researcher (model) · ISSUE-92 · researching activation transport · running 47s ...`), truncated to fit the row budget (~60 chars), sourced from the bead at dispatch time.

SCOPE: Specialists repo only: extract the excerpt in the bead-gate/dispatch path (which already holds the validated contract -- first meaningful line of SCOPE, falling back to SUCCESS), store on ActivationSnapshot as an optional purpose field, project through toActivationView, render truncated in renderFleetRowLine, unit tests.

NON_GOALS: No per-tick bd subprocess (excerpt captured once at dispatch; tick stays an in-memory read); no full SCOPE text in rows; no Claude-side work.

CONSTRAINTS: Excerpt must be cheap and bounded (truncate ~60 chars, single line, whitespace-collapsed). Absent/unreadable bead => field omitted, never fabricated. Suite green, tsc clean; dist rebuilt+committed only if src changes.

VALIDATION: Unit tests (excerpt extraction, truncation, omission when absent, row contains excerpt); live row shows a purpose excerpt during a contracted dispatch.

OUTPUT: Code + tests on a specialists branch, evidence in bead notes.

SCRUTINY: low
source.notes: SCOPE AMENDMENT 2026-09-08 (operator directive, joins the purpose-excerpt work in the same row renderer): (1) elapsed always renders in seconds (243s, never 4m3s); (2) token totals render for settled activations too, not only running ones -- final spend stays visible after settle. Both covered by the same row-format tests.
source.title: Fleet rows show dispatch reason excerpted from the bead
